title: Edit PDF tool UI
acceptance: cargo test -p pdfxi-app --features ui,pdfium; A-17 and A-23 work on a real document in all four theme/control combinations
notes: App half of the Edit PDF pair per ADR 0012, serialised after T-0233. Serves acceptance items A-17 (click a paragraph, edit it, reflow; the saved file shows and extracts the new text) and A-23 (Edit PDF tool) from docs/design/FEATURE_ACCEPTANCE.md. Adds the text-block selection overlay, the edit box with handles, add text and add image, and applies every change through the pdfxi-document session and the T-0233 library API; the shell must not re-implement text geometry. Object move/resize/replace/delete of existing objects stays out: it remains EDIT-004 at `model` per the T-0233 acceptance. Feature-matrix rows stay as the library left them until this task verifies them. A-23 is not ticked by A-17 alone: it also needs the T-0265 object transform ops, so this task adds a selection overlay, drag/resize handles, Delete and Replace on top of the text-block editing.
